scene: The brass projector shoots glowing blue cat cartoons straight into the clouds.
picture: Pixel art rooftop in flat side view. Left, a glowing beam arcs skyward from a polished brass cloud projector. Centre, the Pacific Islander teenage girl in sky-blue windbreaker adjusts brass dials, beside slide reels. Right, an empty red striped deckchair holds a neon umbrella. Far right, a metal spiral ladder ascends the marquee tower.
shown: a circular rack of glass slide reels on the projector's side, centre
a forgotten neon-rimmed umbrella propped against an empty striped deckchair on the right
a painted metal fire ladder attached to the cinema marquee, far right
